exercises.question: Which sentence combines a hypothetical situation with probability?
options: Si cambiara la situación, probablemente cambiarían nuestras decisiones. [If the situation changed, our decisions would probably change.]
La situación cambia. [The situation changes.]
Probablemente cambiarán nuestras decisiones en esta situación. [Our decisions will probably change in this situation.]

exercises.sentence: En ese __, podría ocurrir algo inesperado.
exercises.english: In that scenario, something unexpected could happen.
It would be difficult to know what outcome we would have.

sentences: Primero, pensamos en otra vida. [First, we think about another life.]
Después, decimos: si viviéramos en otro lugar, tendríamos una vida diferente. [Then we say: if we lived somewhere else, we would have a different life.]
Finalmente, no sabemos si sería mejor. [Finally, we do not know whether it would be better.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué pasaría si viviéramos en otro lugar?

options: Quizá tendríamos una vida diferente. [Perhaps we would have a different life.]
Quizá tuvimos una vida diferente. [Perhaps we had a different life.]
Quizá habíamos tenido una vida diferente. [Perhaps we had had a different life.]
Podría ocurrir algo inesperado. [Something unexpected could happen.]
Ocurrió algo inesperado. [Something unexpected happened.]
Pueda ocurrir algo inesperado. [Something unexpected may (subjunctive) happen.]
Probablemente cambiarían nuestras decisiones. [Our decisions would probably change.]
Probablemente cambiaron nuestras decisiones. [Our decisions probably changed.]
Probablemente cambiaran nuestras decisiones. [Our decisions probably were to change.]
